en.title: Longest Consistent Log Segment
en.description:
Given an array of player IDs. First find k, the minimum number of occurrences among all players that appear in the whole array. Find the longest contiguous subarray in which the most frequent player appears exactly k times. Output its length.

The input format, examples, and test data are compiled and written by CSWork.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..10000); the second line contains n player IDs. By this site's judging convention, IDs are integers in 1..10⁹.
en.output: Output the answer as described; multiple results are separated by spaces, in order.
en.explanation: The example inputs and outputs follow the rules above directly; see the solution for the full algorithm.
hints: Use a sliding window that keeps every player's occurrence count at most k. After adding a new player, if their count exceeds k, move the left end until the window is valid again, and record the longest window.
